title: Agora
tagline: A platform to help model owners monetize and host their models completely offchain
description:
Model owners encrypt their intellectual property and make it available through a "Data DAO." The data is encrypted and can only be accessed by people who have the token for a limited time. 

Users purchase a token to get secure, temporary access to run the model. Payments go directly from user to owner—instantly and without a commission.
how_its_made: I used next js with wagmi + rainbowkit + lighthouse for filecoin and smart contract interactions. For smart contracts I used solidity - hardhat for deploying and testing. For the backend I have 2 components 1 is the python backend which does the inferencing while the other node backend ensures that the user has access to the files uploaded
